gen-press-start-2p-gf-hedvig-letters-san: Playful and retro, Press Start 2P spaces its letters out like cut-outs pinned far apart on a board. Hedvig Letters Sans follows with a wide gap where the c ends and small letters nearly as tall as capitals, so a long passage feels open and friendly.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-heebo: Chunky pixel charm, with a faint wedge-shaped pressure in each curve of Press Start 2P that only shows up close. Its bowls run big; Heebo is the quieter one, with a tall central band and curves that stop short.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur reads modern and level, its strokes like steel cable with no thick-thin shift at all. Press Start 2P up top has thin parts that are clearly lighter yet never fragile, so give the Hind Guntur text a little extra size to let its tall forms breathe.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai fills each line with lowercase that stands nearly as tall as capitals, its stroke ends cut as if from one ribbon. Press Start 2P is the one for fun, retro display; Hind Madurai handles the steady text.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-hind-mysuru: Press Start 2P swells its strokes moderately and spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned wide apart, which gives it a retro, toy-like presence. Hind Mysuru sits below with no swelling where curves meet stems, so the two stay distinct.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums along with constant line weight, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle and its capitals only slightly taller than the small letters. And Press Start 2P brings the fun, retro punch with light contrast, while Hind Siliguri does the steady, approachable work of the text.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-hind-vadodara: Professional in tone, yet Press Start 2P still hides a quiet stroke modulation under its retro, far-apart letter spacing. Hind Vadodara then bends its strokes like cable, with no swelling or thinning, and spacious gaps in its rounded glyphs.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-huninn: Huninn keeps its lowercase rising close to cap height, with crossbars as fat as the stems they join and s terminals held clear of the body. Press Start 2P sets a half-turned flat brush of middling contrast above it, and the pair feels crisp.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-inter-tight: Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart, with diagonals a touch lighter than the verticals. Inter Tight is the plain counterweight, its lines like bent tubing and its curve tails held well back.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-karla: Fun and a little retro, Press Start 2P keeps a tempered thick-thin variation that never reaches razor-fine hairlines. But Karla is the one for sustained text, with a gaping c opening and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky.
